about: WOOF forecast-file variables as GRIB2 (RunOutput.fileFormat grib2/both): read by workers/gpu/rw_history_grib2 on the box and by the site (which variables of a pick GRIB2 carries). Each parameter row is a standard WMO GRIB2 parameter (code table 4.2) or, marked local, an NCEP local-use entry (centre 7, local table 1). Values are written as their own 32 bits (template 5.4) or exact integer packing, never converted or rounded, so a row exists only where the file's units are the parameter's. level: surface (1), height:H (103), top (8, nominal top of the atmosphere), column (10, entire atmosphere), agl-layer:TOP:BOTTOM (103-103), model:1 (hybrid level 1), model (the file's own levels: hybrid level 105 = model level k from the ground, soil level 151 = soil level k, isobaric 100 = P_PL in Pa). stat with window run = since the forecast's start (template 4.8), window output = since the previous output time. wind: grid-relative components on a Lambert grid (flag table 3.3 bit 5). Built by tools/output-files/build_grib2_table.py.
